run_check_copies: run the check_copies script to verify all copied code matches the original diffusers source
run_check_copies_fix: run check_copies with --fix_and_overwrite to automatically fix copy inconsistencies in diffusers source files
find_code_in_diffusers: find the source code of a named class or function within the diffusers module
stylify_code: stylify a block of Python code by running it through ruff format and preserving indentation
check_copy_consistency: check if code marked as copied from diffusers in a file matches the original source
